agent_notes: Government directory listing confirmed on all three supplied 2025 NIRF pages; each shows Medi-Caps University, Indore, Madhya Pradesh.
Normal TLS requests failed with the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was used only for public GETs to expected NIRF, search, and medicaps.ac.in hosts.

The official catalogue exposes 45 undergraduate, 24 postgraduate, 10 doctoral, 4 value-added certification, and 1 integrated programme entries; all catalogue-linked official programme pages were reachable.

Duration remains null for 16 entries where the central catalogue does not explicitly state it; programme identity and catalogue inclusion were still established from the official catalogue and programme pages.
Eligibility is left null because the central catalogue was used for scalable verification; programme detail pages contain eligibility sections but those fields were not bulk-imported.

The official About page describes the institution as private, while INSTITUTION_CONTEXT labels it state_university; the supplied identity and government-listed campus were retained, and the classification discrepancy is noted for downstream review.
